messages.1000002:
I'm glad you came.
I'm Kyle, and I'm in charge of
this operation.
messages.1000003:
Although I command the operation,
I leave everything in the hands of the warriors.
I basically look for results, that's all.
messages.1000004:
That person over there is Kurt, my subordinate.
If you have any questions, ask him.
messages.1000005: I'll give you a task right away.
messages.1000006:
Supplies and items for the operation are stocked here.
A group of thieves belonging to the Demon Tribe is scheming
to steal these supplies.  They're in the Forest of Claws to the
southeast of town.  I want you to take out the group of thieves first.
messages.1000007:
If you defeat the leaders of the group, the whole group may lose
its power. So, I suggest you take aim at them.
messages.1000008:
If you accomplish your mission, please come back to me.
Well, get started.
messages.1000009:
There are a variety of warriors.
Some of them are more helpful than knights...
Knights look strong but don't have much actual skill.
messages.1000010:
Good job.
First, here is a reward for your work. Take it.
messages.1000011:
As for your next duty, I want you to investigate
a mining tunnel which is used for our operation.
The tunnel is far south from here.
messages.1000012:
You need to go through the Forest of Elves on your way.
I'm negotiating to get permission for you to cross,
but for the time being, just try to sneak through.
messages.1000014:
I cannot believe what you've done..
You destroyed the legendary dragon!?
messages.1000015: I wasn't expecting such results from you...
messages.1000016:
As long as there are warriors like you,
there is hope in this dark era.
messages.1000017: I may be talking to a real hero.
messages.1000018:
You have the ability to overcome any hardships in your path.
I'm convinced that you can do it.
messages.1000020:
Couldn't you pass through the Forest of Elves?
The negotiations do not appear to be going smoothly.
messages.1000021:
The cause may be the legendary dragon
of old lore.
messages.1000022:
The dragon is sleeping somewhere in a mine.
He was cast there by a wizard encased in his magic shield ...
messages.1000023:
Although he is still at the larva stage, he used to have
enough power to sink a country into a sea of fire.
messages.1000024:
The elves are always worried about
the revival of the dragon.
messages.1000025:
If our army uses the mining tunnel as they like,
it's indeed possible that the dragon may awaken.
We may have an adverse affect on the Seal Facilities.
messages.1000026:
It seems that the elves are deeply concerned
about this matter.
messages.1000027:
We must somehow gain help from someone who is familiar with
the Seal Facilities and persuade the elves to let us pass....
messages.1000028:
The one who sealed away the dragon is a famous wizard, Kirushutat.
He has a tower in the inner part of the Forest of Spirits,
towards the east of Cross Agora.
messages.1000029:
I want you to meet him and ask for his cooperation
in persuading the elves.
messages.1000030: The Solk virus has been prevalent in this town recently.
messages.1000031:
The reconstruction of the Solk District had been delayed
because of the prolonged war.  Due to poor sanitation,
a virus developed and has plagued the area.
messages.1000032:
With the Medicine of the Elves,
the virus is not so lethal..
messages.1000033: But we are short of medicine right now.
messages.1000034:
The remedy is made in a herb garden that Gebal the merchant owns.
We've been unable to obtain more of the remedy.
This has been a bad year for us.
messages.1000035:
The greedy merchant asked a preposterous price
for more of the remedy.
messages.1000036:
We have doubts about the merchant's methods of operation,
but we cannot get into his place for investigation..
messages.1000037:
It's because the area belongs to the elves.
If we make things worse, our operation may be delayed.
messages.1000038:
According to a story we heard, a leader of the elves put Gebal
in charge of the herb garden to promote friendship between
human beings and elves.
messages.1000039:
We are irritated by Gebal's business methods,
but there's nothing we can do right now.
messages.1000040:
Sorry, but we cannot help you
with the herb garden.
messages.1000041:
I heard your story.  You worked hard on the herb garden dilemma.
Thanks to you, our army has sufficient supplies of the remedy.
messages.1000042:
You are much greater than what's being said about you.
We feel safe relying on you from now on.
messages.1000043:
Milia isn't having any problems running her business.  The Guild also
gave its consent because this is a special case.
messages.1000044:
Hi, I'm Kurt and I help oversee this operation.
Nice to meet you.
messages.1000045:
Your main objective is to secure the road
so our army can carry out a surprise attack.
messages.1000046:
An old mine tunnel will be used
as a passageway for the operation.  I want you
to investigate the tunnel and secure it.
messages.1000047:
There's also a group of thieves
hanging around here who are stronger
than we expected.
messages.1000048:
They have fairly good combat prowess because
they were organized by deserters of the Demon Tribe.
messages.1000049:
Although we have not confirmed it yet, military officers who are
in the upper ranks of the Demon Tribe may also be in the group.
messages.1000050:
We don't know why the deserters
keep targeting our supplies,
but we can't waste any more of our time.
messages.1000051:
An allied army was also surrounded by the group. If they're caught,
we can't abandon them.  Go ahead and scout the area.  Good luck.
messages.1000053:
Wow.  Great... I wouldn't do this..
Well, nothing..
messages.1000054:
I expect nothing but success from you.
Good luck!
messages.1000055:
Since the Solk virus became prevalent, a shortage of the medicine
has become a serious problem.  Milia, a holy spirit witch,
buys the medicine and gives it to poor people.
messages.1000058:
Does she charge for her cure?
It would make sense. She paid for the medicine.
messages.1000059:
It's illegal conduct if she charges without the Guild's permission,
but she does. She doesn't have bad intentions though.
messages.1000060:
I'll keep her conduct a secret for a while.
It may become a serious problem if the secret gets out...
messages.1000061: Well, it has nothing to do with me.
messages.1000062:
The price of medicine has risen sharply?
It may be due to a poor
harvest of the herb.
messages.1000063:
Even though a bad rumor about the supplier of the medicine is
circulating, it seems natural for him to want to earn money.
messages.1000064:
Cortes did similar things.  He made a large
profit gathering the town's medicine supplies,
didn't he?
messages.1000065:
If I had the resources, I would earn a lot of money too..
It's none of my business though.
messages.1000066:
If I become impatient, I may lose this battle.
(Sigh)
messages.1000067:
Well, about the suspicion surrounding Gebal...
controlling the price of medicine
and bribing inspectors..I don't really care about it,
but I do feel bad because it involves people's lives.
messages.1000068:
What? Should I be mad about this situation?
You want me to disagree with my superiors?
messages.1000069:
It doesn't matter because my opinion isn't relevant...
I have nothing to do with the matter...
messages.1000070:
Please don't ask people who have nothing to do with something
questions that will only embarass...
messages.1000071:
Oh, you are great. I believed you would make it.
It's true!
messages.1000073:
I made a lot of money because of the war.
I can't help laughing! Ha ha ha!
messages.1000074:
Oops.  Please forget my imprudent words.
Ha ha ha !
messages.1000075:
Let's spend some money quick.  What should we do next?
Ha ha ha!
messages.1000076:
Do you think the price of the medicine is high?
Well, there is nothing I can do. The price is dictated by demand.
messages.1000077:
You should talk to Gebal if you have complaints...
Oops.  Please forget I said that!
messages.1000078:
So what?  I'm running my business properly.
I don't know anything about other people!
messages.1000079:
I said I don't know about Gebal!
.......
messages.1000080:
Don't show me such a fierce face.
I don't know anything about it.
messages.1000085: Stop staring at me and smiling.
messages.1000086:
All right!  I'll tell you the story!
And why are your eyes and body shining!?
messages.1000088:
There is a rumor that Gebal is hiking the price of medicine
without consulting anyone while the leader of the elves is away.
messages.1000089:
We made a large profit by dealing items and munitions in this war.
There is a strong demand for the Medicine of the Elves.
Although we've sold a lot of it, there is still a tremendous demand.
messages.1000090:
Gebal secretly kept a hidden stock of the medicine and when the price
of the medicine rose, he sold it on the black market.  You can
imagine how much he earned from this.
messages.1000091:
The lack of medicine in the public market was caused by him.
He must have found a customer who could buy a big order.
The battle on the front line has become severe because of him.
messages.1000092:
Although everyone points their fingers at him, there is nothing
we can do because inspectors deny our suspicions.
messages.1000093:
In short, those inspectors are in cahoots with him.
They are part of his dirty scheme.
messages.1000095:
That's enough, isn't it?
Stop staring at me!
messages.1000096:
I asked about Gebal..
and I was scolded harshly!
Our discussion is over..
messages.1000097:
Forgive me!
I did't do anything wrong!
messages.1000098:
How can I help you?
 
 ・~Buy Armaments         ~
 ・~Buy Equipment         ~
 ・~Identify Items        ~
 ・~Repair Items          ~
                               ~QUIT~
messages.1000099:
・~Arms               %9d Gold~
 ・~Head Armor         %9d Gold~
 ・~Body Armor         %9d Gold~
 ・~Shield             %9d Gold~
 ・~Leg Armor          %9d Gold~
 ・~All Equipped Items %9d Gold~
 ・~Non-Equipped Items %9d Gold~
                           ~QUIT~
messages.1000102:
To identify your item, it costs %d in Gold.  Is that OK?
 
                          ~YES~  ~NO~
messages.1000104:
I'm Milia.
I was dispatched recently.
Nice to meet you.
messages.1000105:
Looks like you've received a lot of money from the army?
Sorry to say, but I'll have to charge you if you want treatment.
messages.1000107: You'll need money if you want to receive my treatment.
messages.1000108:
Is it illegal to charge for my cure?
I knew it!
messages.1000109:
If you have complaints, you can tell your superiors.
I don't care if the Guild expels me!
messages.1000110: ..What a greedy man!  Doesn't he think about people's lives?
messages.1000111:
Oh, I'm sorry!
I wasn't paying attention..
messages.1000112:
I'll cure you soon if you're injured.. Oops, I shouldn't have said that!
Give me money for the treatment!
messages.1000113:
What?  Don't look at me strangely.
You don't like me charging for the treatment?
messages.1000114:
I don't care.  If you don't like me,
you can go to someone else and ask for a cure!
messages.1000115:
So what?
I don't want to charge you, but...
messages.1000117: I have to charge because medicine is expensive.
messages.1000119:
Well, thank you for everything.
I appreciate your efforts...
I think I'll eventually be fired as a holy spirit technician.
I'll cure you for free until then,
so please stop by...
messages.1000120:
All I can do is cure your wounds.
I'm sorry...
messages.1000122:
People begged them not to expel me
from the holy spirit technicians ....
messages.1000124:
Well, I can cure you
from now on.
messages.1000125: That's what I wanted to say.
messages.1000127:
I'll charge 200 in gold for my treatment. Is that O.K.?
 
                     ~YES~  ~NO~
messages.1000128:
You're not hurt.
Please take care of yourself...
messages.1000129: Well, if you need me later, come back.
messages.1000130: Holy spirits, please cure his injuries.
messages.1000131:
Holy spirits!
Please remove this person's pain.
messages.1000132: I'm sorry.  You don't have enough money.
messages.1000134:
Welcome!
Welcome to the mining town of Kanfore!
messages.1000135:
Just between you and me, this town has been
active lately because of the army!
messages.1000136:
We've made a lot of money
since the army set up their base here!
messages.1000137:
A major virus is raging these days.
Please take care of your health.
messages.1000138:
Hey, let's make a lot of money and then spend it in this town.
Let's have some fun together!
messages.1000139:
Hey, warrior.  Can you believe that holy spirit technician over there?
She has a cute face, but she charges me.  I can't believe it!
messages.1000140:
I fell down and couldn't get up.
She charged me no less than 3 gold!
What a greedy woman!
messages.1000141:
I was so upset that I made her lower the price to 1 gold.
She insisted that she couldn't cover the cost of medicine
with such a price.  I bet that's a load of crapola!
messages.1000142:
Holy spirit technicians have been curing for free
since I was a child.  What's the deal?!
messages.1000143:
Even though she pretends to be a good person,
she's doing it for money...
messages.1000144:
What?  She risked being dismissed for illegal conduct
by paying for the medicine for the people?
messages.1000145:
I can't believe your story!
It's been so long since I've run across a good person!
messages.1000146:
After all, who puts anything before money?
Yours is too good of a story.
messages.1000147:
Ah...
Should I say good-bye to him?
messages.1000148:
He doesn't work at all.
My cure is free only for those who work hard!
messages.1000149:
Those who don't pay taxes should thank me
because I cure them for reasonable prices.
messages.1000150:
Other holy spirit technicians charge more for this treatment.
He doesn't understand that...
messages.1000151:
That girl never used to charge for her treatment.
What happened to her?
Was she tricked by a strange man?
messages.1000153:
I sympathize with her.
She seems to have had a hard life.
Those who look down on her should be ashamed.
messages.1000154:
Well, I don't have to worry about being careful anymore.
I've caught the Solk virus.
messages.1000155:
As for the name of the virus, it was discovered
in the Solk District. It's very contagious but
not so serious if you have the medicine..
messages.1000156:
(Cough)
I'll be all right because I'm strong,
but the weaker ones...
messages.1000157:
The virus spread quickly and the symptoms grew
worse..The virus was unstoppable until a cure was found.
messages.1000158: I will survive for Lina.. I'll be all right..
messages.1000159:
I cannot die until my daughter
can find happiness on her own.
messages.1000161:
Milia, who lives over there, always gives me medicine.
She said that I shouldn't hesitate to take it
because it's from the Guild's town supply.
But, I feel something's wrong..
messages.1000162:
Oh, here you are!
Thanks to you, the shortage of the medicine has been resolved,
and everyone has recovered from the illness!
messages.1000163:
I thank Milia, too.
I heard that it was illegal for her
to charge for the cure...
messages.1000164:
I didn't know she sacrificed her career to
buy and distribute the medicine.
messages.1000165:
We are now preparing a petition.
I think we can get it to pass!
It's time for us to help her.
messages.1000166:
You helped us a lot.  Thank you very much.
We will always support you.
messages.1000167:
Dad... If he took the Medicine of the Elves,
he could recover soon...
messages.1000168:
Why has the price of the medicine been rising these days?
We cannot afford to buy at such a high price.
messages.1000169:
The same thing has happened to others.
If Milia didn't give us the medicine,
no one would survive..
messages.1000170:
Recently, Milia hasn't been looking so good..
I wonder if I should get some medicine from her or not..
messages.1000171:
Oh!  Thank you very much!
My father has recovered completely!
messages.1000172:
Milia turned out to be fine, too!
It's really great!
messages.1000173:
Well, nice to meet you.
You look great.
messages.1000174:
Someone like you could...
Well, nothing...
messages.1000175:
Oh, this girl is Uta and she's an Elf.
The relationship between human beings and elves is delicate,
but we can get along quite well.
messages.1000176:
Be happy.
That's the most important thing.
messages.1000178:
I'm sorry,
but please leave me alone..
messages.1000179:
The rumor that the army has been active is true.
The forest may be shut down again.
messages.1000180: Royx and I used to fight against monsters at the central battlefield.
messages.1000181:
Human beings and elves have stayed away from each other,
but if we battled side by side, we could overcome our
differences...
messages.1000182:
But elves and humans continue to be alienated from each other.
We are given the cold shoulder by some people...
messages.1000183: If we fought together, nothing could defeat us.
messages.1000184:
I heard that the virus is rampant.
The Medicine of Elves, which works well for the sickness,
should be cultivated in that field...
messages.1000185:
A shortage of medicine!?
This has not been a bad year for the medicine.
Strange...
messages.1000186:
I heard a bad rumor about the man
who guards the herb garden.
messages.1000187:
They might say scandalous things about him out of envy
because he is well-off, but something might happen...
messages.1000189:
What?
The guard of the herb garden..?
messages.1000190:
That's why the price of medicine is skyrocketing.  What a shame.
Elves and human beings have cooperated so well to grow the herb garden.
messages.1000191:
But, if the suspicion and paranoia increases,
the relationship between elves and human beings will go downhill.
We should do something.
messages.1000193:
Well, we could talk to Burns the Elf Ranger who protects
the Forest of Silence to the southwest of town.
He may be able to deal with the situation!
messages.1000194:
He's an elf and he believes friendship with humans is important
so he might be willing to help solve this problem. He also has
ties with both sides. Would you please go talk to him?
messages.1000195:
The Forest of Silence is located to the southwest of this town.
Check the map and try not to go in the wrong direction.
messages.1000196:
You made it! Congratulations. Most people can't deal with
the situations you've faced, but you're different!
messages.1000197:
You're capable of achieving what
others cannot.
messages.1000198:
We won't give up.
Thank you very much!
messages.1000199:
Oh,  I've heard a great deal about you.
Nice to meet you.
messages.1000200:
I'm Gebal and I'm in charge of the guards around this area.
Hu hu hu ...
Please make friends with the others.
messages.1000202:
Medicine?
Yes, we cultivate medicinal herbs here.
messages.1000203:
From the story I've heard, it's a bad
year for the herbs.
messages.1000204:
Well, I just command the guards,
so if you have any inquiries, please ask a manager...
messages.1000205:
The manager belonging to the Elf Tribe seems to be somewhere far off now.
It'll be difficult to meet with him.
...Hu hu hu.
messages.1000206:
I think
you should be more mature...
messages.1000207:
Well, what happened?
Did you hear nasty rumors about me?
messages.1000208:
Oh, calm down.
It's true that I've amassed a bigger fortune than most.
messages.1000209:
It's due to hard work and God's will.
Yes, God acknowledges my hard work.
To thank him, I offered a large donation.
messages.1000210:
The priest was very appreciative.
Impressive, huh?
No one among you can draw such smiles
from God's followers.
messages.1000211:
It is because I have a sacred mind and offer my private property.
If I were blind with greed, I would not do that.
messages.1000212:
In addition,, my innocence has already been proven.
An official investigator concluded I was innocent.
messages.1000213:
So if you doubt my innocence,
you also doubt the country, the king, and God, too.
You should give some thought to that.
messages.1000214:
Well, it might be a waste of time
to tell this story to a warrior like you...
messages.1000215:
If you were born in a richer family,
you would live a more valuable life
beyond swords or magic.
messages.1000216:
Even after you have made atonement for your
transgressions in Hell, you had better pray
to God.
messages.1000217:
You don't have anything that you can dedicate to God,
so I'd say you better do a lot of praying!
messages.1000220:
What's wrong with you?
Don't you have any shame?
messages.1000221:
I was selected by God.
You made mistakes...
messages.1000222:
I was ousted from the Guild and was forbidden to run my business?!
A prison sentence was handed down???
messages.1000223:
You're lying!  This is a bad joke...
I have several dealings currently.
messages.1000225: Hey!  Why on earth did you do this...
messages.1000227: All right, how much? How much do you want?
messages.1000228:
You want money, don't you?  Even though you're jealous that God
is on my side. This is too much!
messages.1000229:
You don't know how much money I deal with!
I deal with more money than common people
can earn in their entire lives!
messages.1000230:
If you want money, just tell me.
Why would you treat me so cruelly?
messages.1000231:
You don't like my way of talking?
Then, I'll add even more money.
messages.1000232:
I'll give you enough money to live a carefree life!
How about it?  Wouldn't it be nice?
You wouldn't have to work another day.  Can you imagine?
messages.1000233:
Ordinary people could never afford this lifestyle.
It's the greatest dream of common people everywhere.
I'll make that dream come true for you!  Here!  How do you like that?
messages.1000234:
But you must save me in return! Tell them of my innocence!
You will benefit more by saving me than by saving
thousands of common people! Can't you understand that?
messages.1000237: Ruined... I'm ruined... How will I survive?
messages.1000238:
I'm Brocchi, a blacksmith.
My specialty is ornaments.
messages.1000239:
I can make your arsenal new again! How
about changing the color of your equipment?
messages.1000240:
He he he...
I have good items.
